# RK Bridal Studio

> Bridal and groom makeup artist based in Jalandhar, Punjab, India. HD and airbrush bridal makeup, hair styling, saree/lehenga draping, groom grooming, engagement/sangeet/mehndi/reception looks, family makeup and destination weddings. Travels across Punjab (Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Phagwara, Kapurthala, Hoshiarpur, Patiala, Pathankot, Mohali, Moga, Nawanshahr).

## Facts
- Trial included with every bridal booking (at the Jalandhar studio).
- Hair styling and draping included in bridal looks.
- Bookings confirmed with an advance; written itemised quotes sent on WhatsApp.
- No travel charge inside Jalandhar; transparent travel zones for the rest of Punjab.
